title: 孔子挨饿的那几天
blurb_en: Lost, surrounded and out of food, his students start to lose their tempers. Confucius plays music.
blurb_zh: 迷路、被围、没有饭吃，学生们都生气了，孔子却还在弹琴唱歌。
